set_up.summary: This project can be run using Docker Compose for isolated environments, Makefile for local development tasks, or manual setup with poetry and direct Python execution, with Docker Compose being the most reliable method.

env_vars.name: ENVIRONMENT
env_vars.purpose: Determines configuration mode (DEVELOPMENT, STAGING, PRODUCTION); used by entrypoint.sh, gunicorn.conf.py, and config files to adjust logging, ports, and behavior.

env_vars.name: DATABASE_URL
env_vars.purpose: Overrides PostgreSQL connection string; used in docker-compose.local.yml to ensure connectivity to db service inside container.

env_vars.name: REDIS_PORT
env_vars.purpose: Defines Redis port; defaults to 6379 in compose files; allows non-standard Redis hosting in local environments.

env_vars.name: PORT
env_vars.purpose: Sets application listening port; defaults to 8000 in entrypoint.sh if not set.

env_vars.name: HOST
env_vars.purpose: Sets application bind host; defaults to 0.0.0.0 in entrypoint.sh for container accessibility.

env_vars.name: WORKERS
env_vars.purpose: Number of Gunicorn workers; defaults to CPU count in gunicorn.conf.py but may be overridden via ENVIRONMENT.

env_vars.name: LOG_LEVEL
env_vars.purpose: Controls verbosity of application logs; auto-set by entrypoint.sh based on ENVIRONMENT if not explicitly defined.

env_vars.name: POSTGRES_USER
env_vars.purpose: PostgreSQL superuser account; defined in compose files and loaded via .env or env_file.

env_vars.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
env_vars.purpose: Password for PostgreSQL user; must match value in .env or docker-compose files for successful DB auth.

env_vars.name: POSTGRES_DB
env_vars.purpose: PostgreSQL database name; defaults to 'dbname' in compose files; required for DB initialization.

files_guide.purpose: Development setup using volume mounts to sync src code; enables hot-reload for API, worker, and beat services; uses ./apps/api-main and ./apps/worker-main paths.
Simplified local development using monorepo structure; mounts root directory into container; suitable for local iteration with minimal build complexity.
Staging environment resembling production; uses .env for secrets; includes health checks, same services as development but with production-like isolation.
Production-ready Docker Compose configuration; uses production-stage Dockerfile; disables reload; sets concurrency and environment for high availability.
Multi-stage Dockerfile: base, dependencies, development, and production stages; builds API and worker services with Poetry-managed dependencies; targets different environments.
Dedicated worker service image (for Celery) built from slim-bookworm; installs only necessary dependencies, copies src directly, uses CMD for default worker command.
Gunicorn configuration for production API; dynamically loads settings from src.config; sets workers, logging, and lifecycle hooks.
Main Nginx configuration for reverse proxy, SSL termination, rate limiting, and upstream routing to containerized services (api_backend, dashboard_backend).
Nginx site-specific configs; handles HTTPS redirect, ACME challenge paths, and routes API traffic to api-main:8000 via upstream.
Alembic configuration for database migrations; points to migrations/ directory and configures versioning behavior for PostgreSQL.
Task runner for local development; abstracts Poetry and Alembic commands for installation, migration, testing, linting, and formatting.
Validation script for required tools (Docker, Node.js, Python 3.11+, AWS CLI); ensures environment readiness before running any workflow.
Container entrypoint script; loads .env, normalizes ENVIRONMENT, sets defaults (PORT, LOG_LEVEL), verifies Python packages, and executes Uvicorn or Celery.

overview.summary: This codebase is a FastAPI-driven service that manages GitHub and user integrations, with AI features and persistent data storage. It is structured as a monorepo with clear separation between application logic (src), infrastructure (terraform, docker), and supporting tools (migrations, scripts).

modules.name: src
modules.responsibility: Core application logic, including models, APIs, middleware, and business rules.

modules.name: __root__
modules.responsibility: Application entry point and FastAPI app initialization; orchestrates routing and dependencies.

modules.name: migrations
modules.responsibility: Database schema migrations using Alembic; manages versioned changes to the data model.

modules.name: terraform
modules.responsibility: Infrastructure-as-code for provisioning AWS, Docker, and networking resources.

modules.name: scripts
modules.responsibility: Automation scripts for deployment, data seeding, and maintenance tasks.

modules.name: tests
modules.responsibility: Unit and integration tests for business logic and APIs.

modules.name: docker
modules.responsibility: Docker configuration for local and production containerization of services.

modules.name: nginx
modules.responsibility: Reverse proxy and SSL termination configuration for incoming HTTP traffic.

modules.name: notebooks
modules.responsibility: Exploratory data analysis and prototype development for AI features.

modules.name: workers
modules.responsibility: Background task processing (e.g., async GitHub webhooks, AI jobs).

modules.name: outputs
modules.responsibility: Stores build, log, or output artifacts from CI/CD or batch processes.

modules.name: .ruff_cache
modules.responsibility: Caches linter results for faster development feedback.

modules.name: .kilo
modules.responsibility: Local development configuration for the Kilo editor (if used internally).

flows.description: Authenticates users via Cognito JWT and GitHub OAuth, managing sessions and profile data securely through a structured request-response lifecycle.
risks: JWT verification failure due to expired or malformed tokens could lead to unauthorized access or denial of service.
GitHub OAuth callback mishandling may result in token leakage or incomplete user profile linking.
Race conditions during concurrent user creation or GitHub connection updates could corrupt state.
Missing input validation in profile update endpoints may expose sensitive fields or allow injection.

detail.summary: Authenticates users via Cognito JWT and GitHub OAuth, managing sessions and profile data securely through a structured request-response lifecycle.
The flow begins when a user clicks 'Login with GitHub', which redirects to github_oauth_login, initiating the OAuth2 authorization URL generation.

flows.name: Environment Configuration
flows.description: Loads and applies environment-specific configurations (dev, staging, prod) for secure and scalable deployment.
risks: Incorrect environment variable loading could lead to production secrets being exposed in development.
Misconfigured base config inheritance might cause unexpected behavior across environments.
Failure to load configuration before service startup could result in application crashes or misbehavior.

detail.summary: Loads and applies environment-specific configurations (dev, staging, prod) for secure and scalable deployment.
BaseConfig.__init__ is the foundation; all environment configs extend this class to inherit common settings like database URLs, logging levels, and secret key locations.
DevConfig extends BaseConfig and overrides values for local development, enabling hot-reload and less restrictive security policies.
StagingConfig inherits from BaseConfig and overrides values to mimic production behavior while allowing testing of real integrations without full security lockdown.
ProdConfig extends BaseConfig with critical security settings — secret keys from environment variables, strict CORS, and non-debug error responses.
Uses environment-specific log level (e.g., INFO in staging, ERROR in prod) and output format to ensure traceability without excessive noise.
Fetches dynamic secrets like database credentials, API keys, and JWT public keys from secure external storage during deployment initialization.
Ensures consistent environment variable injection for Docker containers or local dev servers when deployed from CI pipeline.
